name: Q2 Finite Element Compression
definition: A compression scheme for multidimensional functions that uses a hierarchical basis of quadratic polynomials (Q2) to decompose a function into coarse coefficients and detail coefficients, allowing sparse storage based on a threshold.
summary: Q2 Finite Element Compression is a multidimensional scheme using a hierarchical basis of quadratic polynomials to decompose functions into coarse and detail coefficients, enabling sparse storage and linear complexity without separable filter banks.
